This implies that (2S)-2-Amino-4-((carboxycarbonyl)amino)butanoic acid may act as a modulator or inhibitor of Dl-Anabasine, which then influences CX-1. The mechanism is likely mediated through the FcRn pathway, where the compound could either directly interact with FcRn or indirectly affect its activity through Dl-Anabasine. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential role for the compound in regulating CX-1 through a chain of interactions involving FcRn and Dl-Anabasine.
